description: Enhanced edge coverage for parse_module_manifest: manifest with a name but zero parameters, multiple parameters mixing absent label / absent options / options-without-label (verifying empty values are not invented), a manifest with no name key at all (empty name), and a single parameter carrying three options to verify comma-join ordering is preserved in declaration order.

input.manifest:
name: "Multi param"
parameters:
  - field: a
  - field: b
    label: B Label
  - field: c
    options:
      - one

cases.expected_output:
name=Multi param
parameter_count=3
parameter field=a label= options=
parameter field=b label=B Label options=
parameter field=c label= options=one

input.manifest:
name: "Three options"
parameters:
  - field: env
    label: Environment
    options:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

cases.expected_output:
name=Three options
parameter_count=1
parameter field=env label=Environment options=dev,staging,prod
